## 测试内容 / Test content
请使用虚构样本。不要公开工作文档、个人信息或带鉴权参数的图片地址。
Use fictional content. Do not post work documents, personal information or image URLs containing credentials.

## 诊断 ZIP / Diagnostic ZIP
在「剪贴板排查」中点击「读取当前剪贴板」，核对识别结果，再点击「导出诊断 ZIP」。
Open Clipboard diagnostics, read the current clipboard, review the results and export the diagnostic ZIP.

**ZIP 包含原始正文、HTML、图片、链接、文件路径和私有格式，不是脱敏报告。请先检查，确认可公开后再手动拖入此 Issue。**
**The ZIP contains original text, HTML, images, links, file paths and private formats. It is not anonymized. Inspect it before manually attaching it to this public issue.**

不适合公开的诊断包请勿上传，可先描述问题并与维护者商议其他反馈方式。应用不会自动上传或创建 Issue。
Do not upload a ZIP that is unsuitable for public sharing. Describe the issue first and discuss another channel with the maintainer. The app does not upload data or create issues automatically.
